metadata.statusNote: Mapped OSM features (observed = present in OSM), not an authoritative drainage-network inventory.

properties.name: Thai name as tagged (name:th, else name); null if unnamed
properties.kind: river | canal | stream | drain (waterway=drain|ditch) | water-area (natural=water polygons)
properties.osmId: representative OSM element (lowest id of merged members)
properties.widthClass: display class (not a measured width). 3 = the city's principal river (name matching ^คลองอ[ูุ]่ตะเภา), any waterway=river named แม่น้ำ… / '… River', or a river water-area (water=river|riverbank); 2 = a named khlong (name starting คลอง/ลำ/Khlong/Klong; waterway=river|canal|stream) whose same-name ways total >= 3 km inside this bbox or carry a width tag >= 10 m, or a canal water-area; 1 = everything else (incl. unnamed ways)
properties.osmIds: all OSM elements merged into this feature
properties.nameSource: way = name tagged on the OSM element (name:th preferred); sibling = way tagged only with a romanised `name` whose other ways with the identical `name` all carry the same `name:th` (that name:th is used); relation = name inherited from a waterway relation the way belongs to; centreline = Chao Phraya water-area whose parts are (partly) unnamed in OSM and were selected because the waterway=river centreline named แม่น้ำเจ้าพระยา runs through them; none = unnamed

metadata.processing: Overpass 'out geom' -> GeoJSON (in-script converter); ways merged by (kind, name) at shared end nodes, connected pieces grouped per feature; unnamed streams/drains/ditches dropped; unnamed rivers/canals kept with name=null; clipped to bbox, mapshaper -simplify dp interval=4 m (lines) / 5 m (areas), precision 1e-5.
limitations: OpenStreetMap is volunteer-mapped: completeness and positional accuracy vary; absence of a feature in OSM does not mean absence on the ground.
Names are as tagged in OSM (Thai `name:th` preferred, else `name`); some `name` values are romanised (e.g. 'Klong …') or contain typos.
Coordinates are clipped to the city bbox, simplified with mapshaper (Douglas-Peucker) and rounded to 5 decimals (~1.1 m).
